description: This file defines the ControlChannel class and related data structures for managing and communicating with a control channel in an OpenClaw application, including connection management, error handling, event streaming, and routing of control events.

classes.name: ControlChannel
classes.description: A singleton class managing the control channel connection, including configuration, health checks, event streaming, and error recovery.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Configures the control channel in local mode.

methods.name: configure(mode:)
methods.description: Configures the control channel with specified mode (local or remote).

methods.name: refreshEndpoint
methods.description: Refreshes the control channel endpoint, establishing a gateway connection.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Disconnects the control channel and resets related state.

methods.name: health
methods.description: Performs a health check on the control channel.

methods.name: request
methods.description: Sends a request to the gateway with specified method and parameters.

methods.name: friendlyGatewayMessage
methods.description: Generates user-friendly error messages based on gateway errors.

methods.name: scheduleRecovery
methods.description: Schedules a recovery attempt after a connection failure.

methods.name: establishGatewayConnection
methods.description: Establishes and verifies the gateway connection.

methods.name: refreshAuthSourceLabel
methods.description: Updates the label indicating the authentication source.

methods.name: formatAuthSource
methods.description: Formats the authentication source into a display string.

methods.name: startEventStream
methods.description: Starts listening to the event stream from the gateway.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Handles incoming push events from the gateway.

methods.name: routeWorkActivity
methods.description: Routes control agent events to appropriate work activity handlers.

methods.name: bridgeToProtocolArgs
methods.description: Converts OpenClawProtocol.AnyCodable to a dictionary of protocol arguments.
